summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of VizeAtlas Dubai visa application website. Backend: 30/30 API tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 14 user stories tested and working. Core integrations (MongoDB, Emergent object storage, Stripe Flow B checkout, Resend graceful skip) verified. Turkish UI, multi-step application form with validation, file uploads, payment flow, tracking, admin panel all functional.

backend_issues.notes: All 30 backend API tests passed. No issues found.

frontend_issues.notes: All user stories tested successfully. Minor test script limitations prevented full verification of document thumbnail loading in admin detail page, but backend GET /api/files/{file_id} endpoint confirmed working.

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/health returns ok with email_configured=false, payments_configured=true
Backend: GET /api/visa-types returns 5 visa types with correct structure
Backend: GET /api/content/site returns all required content sections
Backend: POST /api/uploads accepts valid images (JPG, PNG), rejects invalid extensions (.txt) with Turkish error, rejects files >10MB
Backend: POST /api/applications creates application with reference code DV-XX######, returns email_notification='skipped'
Backend: GET /api/applications/track works with correct code+surname, returns 404 for wrong surname or unknown code
Backend: POST /api/contact creates contact message successfully
Backend: POST /api/payments/checkout creates Stripe session with checkout_url, returns 404 for unknown application
Backend: GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} returns payment status
Backend: POST /api/admin/login rejects invalid credentials (401), accepts admin@vizeatlas.com/Dubai2026! and returns JWT token
Backend: All /api/admin/* endpoints return 401 without Bearer token
Backend: GET /api/admin/stats returns KPI counts (total, today, payment_pending, reviewing, approved, rejected, revenue, unread_messages)
Backend: GET /api/admin/applications lists applications with pagination, search by reference code works
Backend: GET /api/admin/applications/{id} returns application detail with transactions
Backend: PATCH /api/admin/applications/{id} updates status and adds to status_history
Backend: GET /api/admin/contact-messages lists messages, PATCH /{id}/read marks as read
Backend: GET /api/admin/emails returns email_configured=false and items with status='skipped'
Backend: GET /api/admin/visa-types lists visa types, PATCH /{id} updates price
Frontend: Home page (/) loads with hero 'Dubai vizeniz, karmaşıklık olmadan', pricing cards, WhatsApp button, no console errors
Frontend: /vize-tipleri lists 5 visa types with 'Başvuruya başla' buttons, clicking redirects to /basvuru?vize={id}
Frontend: Info pages render: /gerekli-belgeler, /sss (FAQ accordion), /hakkimizda, /kvkk
Frontend: /basvuru multi-step wizard with stepper and progress bar, validation prevents advancing without visa selection
Frontend: Step 1 (Kişisel Bilgiler) validation: rejects short names, invalid email, missing gender, past passport expiry with Turkish inline errors
Frontend: Step 2 (Seyahat Bilgileri) validation: rejects departure date earlier than arrival date
Frontend: Step 3 (Belgeler) file upload via set_input_files works for passport and biometric photo, shows 'Yüklendi' indicators
Frontend: Step 4 (Özet & Ödeme) displays summary sections (visa, applicant, travel, documents), KVKK checkbox required
Frontend: Clicking 'Ödemeye geç' creates application and redirects to checkout.stripe.com (Stripe hosted checkout)
Frontend: /takip page allows querying by reference code + surname, shows status badge, payment badge, travel dates, amount, status timeline
Frontend: /odeme/iptal page renders with reference code and retry button
Frontend: /iletisim contact form submission works, shows success message
Frontend: /admin without token redirects to /admin/giris
Frontend: /admin/giris rejects wrong credentials, accepts admin@vizeatlas.com/Dubai2026! and redirects to /admin
Frontend: /admin dashboard shows KPI cards (Bugün gelen, Ödeme bekleyen, İnceleniyor, Onaylanan, Tahsil edilen), applications table with 'Detay' buttons, search input
Frontend: /admin/basvuru/{id} detail page loads with applicant/travel/payment/status-history sections
Frontend: /admin/mesajlar lists contact messages with 'Okundu işaretle' button
Frontend: /admin/e-postalar shows email outbox with status='Atlandı' rows and 'E-posta servisi henüz bağlanmadı' warning
Frontend: /admin/vize-tipleri shows visa types with editable prices
Mobile: Mobile menu toggle [data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle'] opens menu at 390x844 viewport
Mobile: /basvuru wizard stepper visible and functional on mobile
